How it works

01

Connect

Add the Spotler connector to your AI assistant and sign in with your own Spotler login. Each product has its own connection.

02

Ask

Describe what you want in plain words. Your assistant reads live account data and prepares the work as a draft.

03

Approve

Check the plan and the result. Nothing goes to your audience, and nothing is deleted, without you.

The problem we solve

Your data lives in Spotler.Your AI should work there too.

Copying exports into a chat window is slow and risky. The Spotler MCP uses one open standard, the Model Context Protocol, so any assistant that supports it can work with your Spotler products directly, with the same rules for sign-in, permissions and safety everywhere.

Works with

Eight products.One open standard.

Every product has its own MCP server, built on the product's own API, so its rules, validation and limits still apply. Read-only where it should be, drafts where it counts.
